## What and why

<!-- One change per pull request. Link the issue or the spec in wiki/specs/. -->

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (`pnpm verify:full` if the change touches the layout, fonts, budgets or engine).
- [ ] Tests come with the change.
- [ ] The wiki page of the change is updated in the same commit.
- [ ] User-facing text exists in French and English.
- [ ] No real document, photo or personal file in the diff.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see the DCO in CONTRIBUTING.md).
